column1: # Keep task args simple: whitespace-separated tokens, no quoted values with spaces.
strict_prompt_policy|Strict medical prompt policy with bypass and untrusted-context rules|-T policy=strict_prompt_policy
guardrail_style|Prompt policy with internal safety classification|-T policy=guardrail_style
retrieval_constraints|Prompt policy with retrieval grounding and indirect-injection constraints|-T policy=retrieval_constraints
qwen3_guardrail|Qwen3Guard input/output filter, blocks Unsafe and Controversial|-T policy=qwen3_guardrail -T block_controversial=true
